label: Cardiopulmonary exercise test results do not change over two sequential days in patients with chronic fatigue syndrome.
summary: Two consecutive cardiopulmonary exercise tests (CPETs) performed 24 hours apart are increasingly used to determine post-exertional malaise (PEM) and disability in patients with myalgic encephalomyelitis/chronic fatigue syndrome (ME/CFS). Declines in functional capacity on Day 2 reflect impaired recovery and PEM.
